urls.rationale: Title 9 Ch. 6 (Lobbyists §§86100-86300): core lobbying registration, expenditure reports, and prohibited activities.
Title 9 Ch. 2 (Definitions §§82000-82054): PRA-wide definitions (lobbyist, lobbying firm, administrative action, etc.) invoked by Ch. 6.
Title 9 Ch. 11 (Enforcement §§91000-91014): PRA-wide enforcement, penalties, and civil actions covering Ch. 6 lobbying violations.

notes: Title 9 (Political Reform) listed in code-gov TOC with chapters matching 2015 ground truth. Three lobbying-relevant chapters selected: Ch. 6 (lobbyists core), Ch. 2 (definitions), Ch. 11 (enforcement).
